solutions.title: Linear lower-bound scan
solutions.strategy: Walk from the front and return the first index with value greater than or equal to target.

timeComplexity.explanation: The scan may inspect every element before deciding the insertion position.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only a loop index is used.

solutions.title: Binary search lower bound
solutions.strategy: Maintain a half-open search range and converge on the first value not less than target.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each iteration halves the remaining search range.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The search uses constant extra variables.
